answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy binds each identity to a bonded proof-of-stake registry, where a plume of attestations from independent peers must corroborate every new agent before it can bridge into the consensus set. Colluding clusters that fabricate identities are detected through cross-attestation graph analysis, isolating fraudulent meadow-like clusters from honest quorum. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
